latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency: 8 cycles for 0/Inf/NaN/negative; 10 for exact squares 1, 4, 0.25 and minnorm; 22 for general non-square inputs; 23 for maxsub and minsub. Measured with an integer-bit reset chain; 5 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. The sample experiment uses 1.0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: fsqrt.s $f0, $f8; fsqrt.s $f1, $f9; fsqrt.s $f2, $f10; fsqrt.s $f3, $f11; fsqrt.s $f4, $f12; fsqrt.s $f5, $f13; fsqrt.s $f6, $f14; fsqrt.s $f7, $f15
throughput.init: li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f8, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f9, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f10, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f11, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f12, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f13, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f14, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f8, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f9, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f10, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f11, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f12, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f13, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f14, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f15, $r4' --asm 'fsqrt.s $f0, $f8; fsqrt.s $f1, $f9; fsqrt.s $f2, $f10; fsqrt.s $f3, $f11; fsqrt.s $f4, $f12; fsqrt.s $f5, $f13; fsqrt.s $f6, $f14; fsqrt.s $f7, $f15'
throughput.notes: Data-dependent throughput: CPI 4.5 for special values; 5.5 for exact squares; 11.5 for general inputs; 12.0 for maxsub and minsub. Throughput is initiation-interval bound.

notes: Latency 8-23 cycles and throughput CPI 4.5-12 are data-dependent; the stored experiments use representative operand samples.
